person.name: Fatima
person.background: Fatima runs a physiotherapy clinic in Riyadh, serving local Arabic-speaking families and a growing number of English-speaking expats. She is cautious about adopting new technology and values simplicity above all.
person.goal: A straightforward online booking system that works seamlessly in both Arabic and English, without confusing her or her staff.

person.name: James
person.background: James is an American expat English tutor based in Dubai, with students across different time zones. He is highly tech-savvy and expects digital tools to be fast, intuitive, and reliable.
person.goal: A smooth calendar sync and instant booking updates in both languages to manage his busy schedule without friction.

person.name: Laila
person.background: Laila is a management consultant in Doha running a small firm. She is skeptical after a negative experience with a previous booking tool and needs a system that proves its worth.
person.goal: A customizable, bilingual booking system with strong support and the flexibility to handle different service types and client needs.
